_about: PF1e conditions for scripts/combat.py: numeric modifiers (atk, dmg, save, check, ac), ability score penalties (str, dex), and flags (flatfooted, str_zero, dex_zero, concealment, prone, helpless, no_move, no_aoo). What the keys mean is defined in scripts/combat_rules.py. Sources: Core Rulebook, Conditions appendix (library/pf1e/rules/conditions.md); the named buffs and debuffs from their spells and abilities. A stat block's effect data names a condition from here, or brings its own cond_mods.

dazzled by light.note: light sensitivity (combat.py adds and removes it)

grappled.note: also -2 CMB except to grapple or escape (not automated)

pinning.note: the grappler holding a pin loses its Dex bonus to AC

dazed.note: can take no actions; no AC penalty

running.note: a run without the Run feat: no Dex bonus to AC until the start of its next turn

total defense.note: +4 dodge (+6 with 3 ranks of Acrobatics: cond --ac 6); no AoOs

blessed.note: bless: +1 morale on attack rolls; also +1 on saves vs. fear (not automated)

aided.note: aid: +1 morale on attack rolls; +1 on saves vs. fear and temporary HP (not automated)

inspired (courage).note: inspire courage +1 (bard 1-4): competence on attack and weapon damage rolls; +1 morale on saves vs. charm and fear (not automated). Higher levels: the ability's own modifiers add on top

inspired (competence).note: inspire competence +2 (bard 3-6), on one skill: the DM applies it to that skill only

evil eye (attack rolls).note: witch hex: -2 on attack rolls (the witch's choice; see the other evil eye entries)

evil eye (checks).note: witch hex: -2 on ability and skill checks
